entities.summary: Hilario Zapata is a Panamanian former professional boxer who competed from 1977 to 1993. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Council (WBC) light flyweight title twice between 1980 and 1983, and the World Boxing Association (WBA) flyweight title from 1985 to 1987.
